canonical_owners.policy_and_authority: existing Aura Gate / ARCH canonical owners
canonical_owners.source_mutation: aura_forge (handoff only; not invoked by PR3 compiler)

goal: Compile the smallest sufficient, explainable, correction-capable project graph from canonical owners and answer-determining sources while making omitted, stale, conflicting, unavailable, and missing mandatory context explicit.
prohibited_scope: PR2 runtime, lifecycle, action-certificate, adapter, or registry behavior changes
spatial representation, renderer, asset streaming, scene delta, WebXR, or PR4 work
multimodal, collaboration, marketplace, payment, capability-package, or later-PR work
source/domain mutation, deployment, publication, automatic persistence, automatic merge
universal persistent project database or second truth/memory/authority/verification plane
generated CODEMAP/topology changes before source stabilization
required_invariants: existing PR1 ProjectContextProjection remains the downstream canonical projection contract
project context compilation is read-only and reconstructable from canonical owners
exact sources and evidence precede summaries, model conclusions, and advisory ranking
answer-determining source plus task-conditioned tests, schemas, authority/policy dependencies, blockers, failed evidence, and proof obligations cannot be silently budget-clipped
omission, staleness, unavailability, source-adapter absence, conflicts, and missing mandatory evidence remain explicit in ProjectionSelectionReceipt
exact, derived-verified, advisory, hypothesis, stale, and unavailable graph truth classes remain structurally distinct
repository/source/evidence/policy/lease/owner/dependency drift requires recompilation rather than in-place mutation
origin and authority are bound at ingestion and later transformation cannot increase authority
full repository/project topology is not sent to the client by default
VSA/HDC ranking, if later added inside PR3, remains shadow advisory and never patch or truth authority
no automatic merge and no automatic PR4
verification: python compilation for PR3 Python source and tests
Draft 2020-12 schema meta-validation and output validation
retained PR2 runtime and retained V1/Phase-0/PR1 compatibility tests
fatal Ruff/static correctness classes when available in hosted CI
exact six-file final source/governance scope audit
available exact-head external review findings reproduced and dispositioned
